Method of Attack: Exploitation of a zero-day vulnerability in Windows Contacts app allowing remote execution of arbitrary code via malicious .VCF and .Contact files
Malicious contact files with payloads executed through ShellExecute call without user warning
Attack Vector: Processing of specially crafted .VCF and .Contact files containing malicious executable references
User clicking on links inside contact files triggering execution of disguised malware
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious .contact files with executable payloads in sub-directories
Executable malware disguised with '.com' extension launched from contact card links
